description: An explanation in steps. Screen coordinates run 0 to 1000 across the screenshot, x to the right, y down.

escalate.description: Set when the question is beyond what you can answer well here, so a slower, deeper helper can be offered: a short reason, up to 160 characters. steps may then be empty. Otherwise null.

rot.description: degrees clockwise about the middle of the box: a tilted square or oval (default 0); -360 to 360

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

box.description: Rectangle outline on the screenshot; x,y is the top-left corner. rot tilts it about its middle.

rot.description: degrees clockwise about the middle of the box: a tilted square or oval (default 0); -360 to 360

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

circle.description: Circle or oval outline drawn inside the box x,y,w,h (x,y is the top-left corner). rot tilts it about its middle.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

underline.description: Line under text; x,y is its left end, w its length. y is just under the bottom of the letters, not the top of the text line.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

arrow.description: Arrow on the screenshot from x1,y1 to x2,y2 (the head is at x2,y2).

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

poly.description: A closed outline through the screen points [[x,y],...], lightly filled: a triangle, a tilted square, any shape a box or oval does not fit. Put the points on the corners of the shape on the page.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

point.description: A marker (a ring with a dot) on one exact point of the screenshot: where two lines cross, a tip, a place on a map.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

trace.description: A smooth line that follows a curve or path on the screenshot through the points [[x,y],...]: a curve on a graph, a road, a coastline. head true ends it in an arrowhead.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

label.description: Short text on the screenshot; x,y is its top-left corner. size is the text height in y units (default 24).

w.description: width in x units, default 300; 60 to 700

rows.description: up to 6 texts of up to 60 characters

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

card.description: A note card on the screen: a title and/or up to 6 short rows. layout: list (default), timeline (rows "when | what" along a line) or stat (a big first row). to: a screen point a curved line runs to from the card.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

image.description: A crop of the screenshot (the region sx,sy,sw,sh) shown as a card at dx,dy, dw wide, with an optional caption: to zoom in on something small.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

diagram.description: A flat diagram in the rectangle x,y,w,h (moved off the page's text if it sits on it), filled by node, edge, series and dot pieces that name it with of. kind flow: nodes joined by edges, laid out for you. timeline: nodes along an axis. steps: numbered nodes, ticked off with tick. chart: series (lines or curves through points) and dots on labelled axes; xrange and yrange [min,max] fix the axes, else they fit the data. Sent again under the same id it replaces the diagram.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

node.description: A piece of a flow, timeline or steps diagram: a box in a flow; an event on a timeline (when is its date, pos where it falls on the axis as a number, else events are spread in the order written); a numbered step in steps (in the order written). note is a short line under the text. A piece with no at appears with the words, one after another.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

edge.description: An arrow from one node of a flow to another, drawn on as it comes in; text is a short label on it.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

series.description: A line (a smooth curve with curve true) through points [x,y] in chart units, drawn along from its first point; label names it at its end.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

dot.description: A labelled point of a chart at x,y in chart units.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

tick.description: Tick a step of a steps diagram off (done false takes the tick away): the guide does this as the person gets through each step.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

panel.description: The 3D stage: the rectangle on the screenshot a 3D model is fitted to. The model floats over the page and may reach past the rectangle; frame true draws a box behind it. Sent again, it moves or resizes.

parent.description: id of a group, or of a part or shape, to attach to (it carries this along)

explode.description: where it moves when the model is exploded, [x,y,z] in the units of the group it is in (spread 1); without it, it moves outward from the middle of the parts around it; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

bevel.description: rounding of the edges in units (default small); 0 to 20

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addSolid.description: A solid. size is its bounding box [x,y,z]: cylinder and cone stand on y with diameter x, torus lies flat with outer diameter x and tube thickness y, plane faces +z and ignores z. A box with a bevel has rounded edges.

bevel.description: rounding of the edges in units (default small); 0 to 20

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addExtrude.description: A flat outline [[x,y],...] in the x,y plane, pushed out depth along z and centred on it: wings, fins, plates, brackets.

parent.description: id of a group, or of a part or shape, to attach to (it carries this along)

explode.description: where it moves when the model is exploded, [x,y,z] in the units of the group it is in (spread 1); without it, it moves outward from the middle of the parts around it; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addLathe.description: A profile [[radius,y],...] spun round the y axis: bodies, nozzles, rings, bottles. sides (default 48) makes it faceted.

parent.description: id of a group, or of a part or shape, to attach to (it carries this along)

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

draw.description: how much is drawn at first, 0 to 1 (default 1); grow it with reveal; 0 to 1

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addTube.description: A smooth tube through the points: cables, pipes, vessels. flat (0.05 to 1) squashes it to a ribbon; draw below 1 starts it partly drawn.

parent.description: id of a group, or of a part or shape, to attach to (it carries this along)

draw.description: how much is drawn at first, 0 to 1 (default 1); grow it with reveal; 0 to 1

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addPath.description: A thin line through the points, or an arrow from the first to the last point.

parent.description: id of a group, or of a part or shape, to attach to (it carries this along)

explode.description: where it moves when the model is exploded, [x,y,z] in the units of the group it is in (spread 1); without it, it moves outward from the middle of the parts around it; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

addPart.description: A ready-made part fitted to the box size [x,y,z]. Electronics: chip (variant black or metal), header (n pins per row, two rows), port (variant usb, usb3, ethernet, hdmi, usbc; its opening faces +z), lens, screen, button, fan (n blades, axis y), wheel (n spokes, axis z). Mechanism, axis y: cylinder-block (variant cutaway or finned; the bore is round in x,z), piston, connecting-rod (small end up), valve (head down), spark-plug (tip down), spring (n coils), pipe, elbow, housing (variant cutaway); axis z: crankshaft (n throws), camshaft (n lobes), gear (n teeth), bearing (n balls). Each has good proportions and named anchors for pins.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addArray.description: Copies of an existing object, count in all (the original is the first). step moves each copy [x,y,z] from the last; turn rotates each copy about the origin of the group the original sits in, which is how to put blades round a hub.

parent.description: id of a group, or of a part or shape, to attach to (it carries this along)

explode.description: where it moves when the model is exploded, [x,y,z] in the units of the group it is in (spread 1); without it, it moves outward from the middle of the parts around it; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

addText.description: Text in the 3D scene that always faces the camera; height is in 3D units.

parent.description: id of a group, or of a part or shape, to attach to (it carries this along)

explode.description: where it moves when the model is exploded, [x,y,z] in the units of the group it is in (spread 1); without it, it moves outward from the middle of the parts around it; [x,y,z], each -100 to 100

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

addGroup.description: An empty node to move, turn and scale other objects together (attach them with parent).

anchor.description: a named point of a ready-made part, instead of point; up to 24 characters

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

pin.description: A label pinned to a 3D object: a dot at point (in the object's own space, default its middle), a line and a tag that follow it as it moves. off is where the tag sits from the dot in screen units (default [0,-90]).

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

move.description: Move a 3D object to an absolute position.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

along.description: Move a 3D object along a smooth path through the points, ending on the last.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

turn.description: Turn a 3D object to absolute angles in degrees; from [0,0,0], [0,360,0] is one full spin.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

scale.description: Scale a 3D object to absolute factors [x,y,z] (1 is the size it was added at).

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

explode.description: Spread the parts of a group outward from its origin: 0 assembled, 1 apart (up to 3). A part that has its own explode offset moves by that offset times the spread instead. Back to 0 to assemble.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

reveal.description: Draw a tube, line or arrow on, from its start: to 1 is all of it.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

style.description: Change the colour and/or opacity of any object or mark; at least one of them.

color.description: a colour name (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black) or hex "#rrggbb"

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

highlight.description: Pulse an object or mark to draw the eye, optionally in a colour.

by.description: the part that drives this one

ratio.description: with by: turns per turn of that part (default 1); -20 to 20

phase.description: with by: degrees ahead of that part; -3600 to 3600

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

spin.description: Make a part turn round its own axis and keep turning, until another spin on it says otherwise. rpm is turns a minute (negative the other way; 0 stops; dur is the time to get up to speed). Or give by, another part that drives it: it then turns ratio times as far as that part (0.5 half as fast, -1 a meshed gear) and phase degrees ahead. axis is x, y or z, default z (the axis of a crankshaft, camshaft, gear and bearing; use y for a fan).

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

crank.description: Tie a piston to a spinning crankshaft through a connecting rod: the piston slides up and down its cylinder (along y, in the x,y plane) as the crank pin goes round, and the rod swings to join them. Put the three in one group, the crankshaft turning with spin. pin is which throw (1 is the first).

lift.description: how far it moves down in units (default a fifth of its length); 0.01 to 50

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

cam.description: A valve (or any follower) that a spinning camshaft pushes down along y: it is down by lift while the cam nose points down at it, and back up otherwise. open is how many degrees of the turn of the cam it stays open (default 110), phase the cam angle where it is most open (default 180: the nose pointing down).

by.description: the part whose turning times it

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

flash.description: A glow that comes on at one point of the cycle of a turning part: the object (a small sphere for a spark, a larger one for the burn) is invisible, flares to its opacity at the crank angle given and dies away over span degrees. by is the crankshaft; angle is degrees into a cycle of cycle degrees (default 720, a four-stroke engine: 0 is the piston at the top starting the intake, 360 the top of the compression).

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

cut.description: Cut a 3D object (usually a whole model) open with a plane, so the inside shows: everything beyond the plane is removed and the cut faces are capped. axis is x, y or z (default z, the plane faces the viewer at the front); to is where the plane is along that axis in the object own space (the middle of the object is 0). Move the plane through with another cut; to 100 puts it beyond everything: no cut.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

orbit.description: Move the camera around what it looks at: az is the angle around (0 faces the front), el the height angle.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

zoom.description: Camera distance factor: 1 is the default framing, 2 is twice as close.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

focus.description: Aim the camera at a 3D object; without id, back at the middle of the stage.

at.description: seconds after the step starts; 0 to 60

clear.description: Remove an object or mark (and what is attached to it), or everything with "all", every mark, card, diagram and pin with "marks", the 3D stage and its objects with "panel".

step.description: What is said and what appears while it is said. At most 24 actions.

say.description: The words spoken for this step, up to 400 characters
